Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Object, v As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.SetBackgroundPicture folder & "\bg.png"
    Case 1
        ws.SetBackgroundPicture folder & "\bg.png": ws.SetBackgroundPicture ""
    Case 2
        ws.SetBackgroundPicture folder & "\missing.png"
    Case 3
        ws.SetBackgroundPicture folder & "\bg.png": wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws).SetBackgroundPicture folder & "\bg.png"
    Case 4
        ws.Range("A1").AddComment "n": ws.SetBackgroundPicture folder & "\bg.png"
    Case 5
        ws.SetBackgroundPicture ""
    Case 6
        v = TypeName(ws.SetBackgroundPicture(folder & "\bg.png"))
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & v
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 6
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
